name: Villafáfila (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, red, white and blue, the red charged with two yellow open crowns.
history: The full council of Villafáfila, in session on 3 October 2001, unanimously agreed to approve the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in proportions 2/7, 1/4, 2/7, 1/4 and 2/7, the outer ones blue, the intermediate white and the central red with two yellow open royal crowns.

features.role: two open royal crowns side by side on the red stripe
